services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: You will ascend over the Delaware Valley where you’ll have pristine views of Frenchtown New Jersey, the Delaware River, Round Valley Recreation Area and Spruce Run lakes. Garden State Skydiving has plenty of space to accommodate your friends and family. Bring a cooler, pack a lunch; enjoy the day with all your favorite people. Tandem skydiving might not be what first comes to your mind when thinking about fun activities in New Jersey. Even so, every day more and more people are experiencing the incredible feeling of high-speed freefall over New Jersey’s beautiful Delaware Valley.
